name: fmb-ecosystem
description: GitHub monorepo for the independently deployed FMB/Yoni, SENZ, and Cognita applications.

scripts.build: node --import ./scripts/fetch-shim.mjs scripts/build-release.mjs && node scripts/post-build-fmb-approved-launch.mjs && node scripts/post-build-fmb-final-visual-polish.mjs && node scripts/post-build-fmb-exclude-mabayani.mjs && node scripts/post-build-fmb-safari-readiness.mjs && node scripts/post-build-fmb-mobile-footer-pax.mjs && node scripts/check-fmb-unified-design.mjs && node scripts/check-fmb-approved-launch.mjs && node scripts/check-fmb-public-brand-routes.mjs && node scripts/audit-fmb-enterprise.mjs && node scripts/audit-fmb-performance.mjs && node scripts/audit-fmb-image-integrity-exact.mjs && node scripts/check-dist-links.mjs
scripts.build:all: npm run build:fmb && npm run build:senz && npm run build:cognita
scripts.check: npm run check:structure && npm run check:boundaries
scripts.test: npm run check && npm run check:orchestrator && npm run check:site
